pl.phrase: Inwestujemy tylko w spółki z naszego regionu.

seed.hypotheses_en: Fund deployment pause, fundraising cycle or a polite rejection.
seed.observable_context_en: Published portfolio deployment status and future window
seed.clarifying_question_guidance_en: Ask if there is a definite reopening date.
seed.next_action_en: Remove from active round unless an exact follow-up is agreed.

en.phrase: We're not making new investments right now.

sk.phrase: Momentálne nerobíme nové investície.

cs.phrase: Momentálně neděláme nové investice.

de.phrase: Wir tätigen derzeit keine Neuinvestitionen.

pl.phrase: Obecnie nie realizujemy nowych inwestycji.

seed.hypotheses_en: Formal decision step or a stall.
seed.observable_context_en: Scheduled committee date and due-diligence questions
seed.clarifying_question_guidance_en: Ask what materials and timeline the committee requires.
seed.next_action_en: Supply useful information and agree a check-in.

en.phrase: I need to discuss this with our investment committee.

sk.phrase: Musím to prebrať s investičným výborom.

cs.phrase: Musím to probrat s investičním výborem.

de.phrase: Ich muss das mit unserem Investmentkomitee besprechen.

pl.phrase: Muszę omówić to z naszym komitetem inwestycyjnym.

seed.hypotheses_en: Real diligence or early market research.
seed.observable_context_en: Named reference request and process owner
seed.clarifying_question_guidance_en: Ask the scope, timing and consent needs.
seed.next_action_en: Seek customer permission and prepare references.

en.phrase: Can we speak with your customers?

sk.phrase: Môžeme sa porozprávať s vašimi zákazníkmi?

cs.phrase: Můžeme si promluvit s vašimi zákazníky?

de.phrase: Können wir mit euren Kunden sprechen?

pl.phrase: Czy możemy porozmawiać z waszymi klientami?

seed.hypotheses_en: A genuine compliment, not necessarily funding interest.
seed.observable_context_en: Partner meetings and specific follow-up asks
seed.clarifying_question_guidance_en: Ask what next step would make sense.
seed.next_action_en: Thank them and focus on concrete process evidence.

en.phrase: We're impressed by your team.

sk.phrase: Váš tím na nás urobil dojem.

cs.phrase: Váš tým na nás udělal dojem.

de.phrase: Euer Team hat uns beeindruckt.

pl.phrase: Wasz zespół zrobił na nas wrażenie.

seed.hypotheses_en: Monetization or scale concern, possibly a mismatch.
seed.observable_context_en: Questions about margins, pricing, retention or GTM
seed.clarifying_question_guidance_en: Ask which business-model assumption fails their test.
seed.next_action_en: Validate with real unit economics and experiments.

en.phrase: We like the product, but not the business model.

sk.phrase: Produkt sa nám páči, ale nie váš biznis model.

cs.phrase: Produkt se nám líbí, ale ne váš obchodní model.

de.phrase: Wir mögen das Produkt, aber nicht das Geschäftsmodell.

pl.phrase: Podoba nam się produkt, ale nie model biznesowy.

seed.hypotheses_en: Pricing gap, returns math concern or a negotiation.
seed.observable_context_en: Alternative numbers/terms and continued diligence
seed.clarifying_question_guidance_en: Ask what valuation range and structure could work.
seed.next_action_en: Model dilution and decide whether expectations align.

en.phrase: Your valuation is too high for us.

sk.phrase: Vaše ocenenie je pre nás príliš vysoké.

cs.phrase: Vaše ocenění je pro nás příliš vysoké.

de.phrase: Eure Bewertung ist uns zu hoch.

pl.phrase: Wasza wycena jest dla nas zbyt wysoka.

seed.hypotheses_en: Concern about competition, differentiation or switching costs.
seed.observable_context_en: Specific questions about customer lock-in or IP
seed.clarifying_question_guidance_en: Ask which competitive threat worries them most.
seed.next_action_en: Bring evidence of retention, differentiation and moat.

en.phrase: How defensible is this business?

sk.phrase: Ako sa dokážete ubrániť konkurencii?

cs.phrase: Jak se dokážete ubránit konkurenci?

de.phrase: Wie gut könnt ihr euch gegen Wettbewerber behaupten?

pl.phrase: Jak zamierzacie bronić przewagi przed konkurencją?

seed.hypotheses_en: Worry about contribution margins or scaling efficiency.
seed.observable_context_en: Specific CAC/payback/margin questions
seed.clarifying_question_guidance_en: Ask which metric is the key blocker.
seed.next_action_en: Produce cohort-level economics with transparent assumptions.

en.phrase: We need stronger unit economics.

sk.phrase: Potrebujeme vidieť lepšiu jednotkovú ekonomiku.

cs.phrase: Potřebujeme vidět lepší jednotkovou ekonomiku.

de.phrase: Wir müssen bessere Unit Economics sehen.

pl.phrase: Musimy zobaczyć lepszą ekonomikę jednostkową.

seed.hypotheses_en: Social proof check or coordination of a round.
seed.observable_context_en: Specific commitment/timing questions and continued process
seed.clarifying_question_guidance_en: Ask how co-investor status affects their process.
seed.next_action_en: Provide truthful aggregate fundraising status, not invented FOMO.

en.phrase: What are other investors saying?

sk.phrase: Čo hovoria ostatní investori?

cs.phrase: Co říkají ostatní investoři?

de.phrase: Was sagen andere Investoren?

pl.phrase: Co mówią inni inwestorzy?

seed.hypotheses_en: Conditional future interest or a generic decline.
seed.observable_context_en: Precisely defined milestone and reevaluation date
seed.clarifying_question_guidance_en: Ask what measurable proof point matters.
seed.next_action_en: Track the milestone and keep raising broadly.

en.phrase: We'd like to see you hit the next milestone.

sk.phrase: Radi by sme videli, že dosiahnete ďalší míľnik.

cs.phrase: Rádi bychom viděli, že dosáhnete dalšího milníku.

de.phrase: Wir würden gern sehen, dass ihr den nächsten Meilenstein erreicht.

pl.phrase: Chcielibyśmy zobaczyć, jak osiągacie kolejny kamień milowy.

seed.hypotheses_en: Growing diligence interest or baseline screening.
seed.observable_context_en: Detailed questions and scheduled review
seed.clarifying_question_guidance_en: Ask which scenarios they want to understand.
seed.next_action_en: Send realistic model with assumptions and correct version.

en.phrase: Can you send your financial model?

sk.phrase: Môžete nám poslať finančný model?

cs.phrase: Můžete nám poslat finanční model?

de.phrase: Könnt ihr uns euer Finanzmodell schicken?

pl.phrase: Czy możecie przesłać model finansowy?

seed.hypotheses_en: A non-lead check possibility or a way to defer.
seed.observable_context_en: Written check-size range and explicit lead condition
seed.clarifying_question_guidance_en: Ask how large a check and what conditions apply.
seed.next_action_en: Keep it conditional; prioritize lead fundraising.

en.phrase: We could participate, but we won't lead.

sk.phrase: Mohli by sme sa zapojiť, ale nepovedieme kolo.

cs.phrase: Mohli bychom se zapojit, ale nepovedeme kolo.

de.phrase: Wir könnten mitinvestieren, aber die Runde nicht anführen.

pl.phrase: Możemy dołączyć, ale nie poprowadzimy rundy.

seed.hypotheses_en: Reference diligence, help or market check.
seed.observable_context_en: Specific introduction with planned follow-up
seed.clarifying_question_guidance_en: Ask the purpose of the meeting.
seed.next_action_en: Prepare thoughtfully and respect introduction.

en.phrase: I'd like to introduce you to a portfolio founder.

sk.phrase: Rád by som vás spojil so zakladateľom z nášho portfólia.

cs.phrase: Rád bych vás propojil se zakladatelem z našeho portfolia.

de.phrase: Ich würde euch gern einem Gründer aus unserem Portfolio vorstellen.

pl.phrase: Chciałbym przedstawić was founderowi z naszego portfela.

seed.hypotheses_en: Legitimate committee timing or delay.
seed.observable_context_en: Named milestones, owners and decision date
seed.clarifying_question_guidance_en: Ask about the remaining process and next decision point.
seed.next_action_en: Track timeline and maintain other investor discussions.

en.phrase: Our decision process takes a few weeks.

sk.phrase: Náš rozhodovací proces trvá niekoľko týždňov.

cs.phrase: Náš rozhodovací proces trvá několik týdnů.

de.phrase: Unser Entscheidungsprozess dauert einige Wochen.

pl.phrase: Nasz proces decyzyjny trwa kilka tygodni.

seed.hypotheses_en: Internal momentum, not a guaranteed investment.
seed.observable_context_en: Partner availability and substantive agenda
seed.clarifying_question_guidance_en: Ask which questions should be resolved at next meeting.
seed.next_action_en: Prepare relevant material and clarify next step.

en.phrase: Let's bring another partner into the next meeting.

sk.phrase: Na ďalšie stretnutie prizvime ďalšieho partnera z fondu.

cs.phrase: Na další schůzku přizvěme dalšího partnera z fondu.

de.phrase: Nehmen wir beim nächsten Gespräch einen weiteren Partner dazu.

pl.phrase: Zaprośmy kolejnego partnera na następne spotkanie.

seed.hypotheses_en: Ineligible current stage or formal mandate mismatch.
seed.observable_context_en: Fund typical initial check/stage record
seed.clarifying_question_guidance_en: Ask whether there is any later relevant stage.
seed.next_action_en: Target stage-appropriate funds; no pressure to change mandate.

en.phrase: We don't invest at your stage.

sk.phrase: V tejto fáze bežne neinvestujeme.

cs.phrase: V této fázi běžně neinvestujeme.

de.phrase: In eurer Phase investieren wir normalerweise nicht.

pl.phrase: Zwykle nie inwestujemy na waszym etapie.

seed.hypotheses_en: A definitive no for the current round.
seed.observable_context_en: Written explicit decision
seed.clarifying_question_guidance_en: Ask politely for one actionable takeaway if appropriate.
seed.next_action_en: Close the opportunity and avoid repeated pressure.

en.phrase: We won't proceed with an investment this round.

sk.phrase: V tomto kole nebudeme pokračovať v investičnom procese.
